dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Anaa laa bësu bëgg yoonu raw jaxañ?
dialogue.translation: And what place do you want to aim for in a profession that is worth it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dama bëgg yoonu raw jaxañ ci bësaat man — manex jaxañ ci tang bësu.
dialogue.translation: I want to aim for a profession that is worth it in my dream — but the place is difficult.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sëkka waxal danga yàpp sëkkale ci bës bu raw, doo bësu tang.
dialogue.translation: So that, however, if you have already reached a place that is worth it, you won’t find it difficult.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Lu taxaw nga bësu bëgg yoonu raw jaxañ ci bësaat man?
dialogue.translation: What will you do to aim for a profession that is worth it in my dream?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dama bëgg yoonu raw jaxañ ci bësaat man — dama tidak ci raw seen.
dialogue.translation: I want to aim for a profession that is worth it in my dream — I will stick to what is worth it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Lu bëgg nga bësu ci raw seen tang?
dialogue.translation: What do you want to do in what is worth it but difficult?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dama bëgg fanaa bësu ci tang bësu — man naa ngi sëkkale.
dialogue.translation: I also want to do it in a difficult place — I know it will be tough.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Lu mu ngi genn ci dof am? Mën a wër bés ndax la am?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ndakku ma wër! Lu mu ngi dox ci yoon wi? Am naa xam sa dof.
dialogue.translation: I don’t know yet! How does this person behave in this situation? I know your heart.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Lu mu ngi dox nag ci woon wi? Féer la dox ci laq am.
dialogue.translation: How does this person really behave in this situation? They behave in terms of their voice.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tee, mu ngi wër ci laq am te jotnaa la ci bëggoo.
dialogue.translation: Yes, they know in terms of their voice and help you in your favor.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Féer laa xam! Am naa la bés.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Daw ma liggéey li, man ngi bëgg a tëj yoon wër ciwaam.
dialogue.translation: Start me the work, because I want to teach the writing method in school.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Liggey bi goor la. Ñuy bëgg waxal ci téere bi jëkk.
dialogue.translation: This work is important. They only want to focus on the book.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yoon wër laa bëgg waxal ciwaam, am naa yoon ci wër gi.
dialogue.translation: The writing method is what I want to focus on in school, I have a way in mind for the writing.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Lu bàyyi ci wër gi? Mën naa waxal jënd ciwaam tekk ba jëkk.
dialogue.translation: What did you leave out in the writing? I can focus on teaching in school for just a little time.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Taxaw ci liggéey li, am naa yoon ci wër gi, fak ñuy waxal.
dialogue.translation: Wait for the work, I have a way in mind for the writing so that they can focus.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jëndu ma jënd ci liggéey li, man ngi ci mu ngi bëgg.
dialogue.translation: Teach me the work, because that is what I want.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Fak ñuy waxal ci wër gi, liggéey laa bëgg ci téere bi.
dialogue.translation: So that they focus on the writing, the work I want is in the book.

key_phrases.translation: Start me the work!

key_phrases.phrase: Liggey bi goor la.
key_phrases.translation: This work is important.

key_phrases.phrase: Yoon wër laa bëgg waxal.
key_phrases.translation: The writing method is what I want to focus on.
